types) and the area each occupies in hectares (Ha = values). These are
each areas for different polygons, but I need a summary with only the
total area value in Ha for each type (UNESCO code).

I get melt to work as with other data, but I have been struggling to get
the totals for each variable with a cast statement.

to get it to work.

dcast(veg, UNESCO ~ Ha, sum)
